facts.excerpt: Derry Halloween - Europe’s Largest Halloween FESTIVAL Europe's Largest Halloween Festival Oct 28 - Nov 1 2026 Halloween is coming to Derry. Join us for the Derry Halloween 40th Anniversary in 2026 For four unforgettable nights in October, our ancient Walled City is transformed into Halloween HQ – and you’re on the guest list. Join ghosts, banshees and mystical Celtic creatures as they come out to play on our 400-year-old walls. Marvel at stunning light shows, acrobats and circus performers. Feel the warmth of the Derry welcome and dance alongside thousands of costumed revellers, under a sky filled with fireworks. Halloween is coming to Derry. Are you?
